title: 第1741章 骨翼源帝浮现骨祭军团第1740章 献祭VS涅盘
content_zh:
就在此时，一面由骨白色光纹凝聚而成的白骨盾牌，凭空出现在小七眉心前。
骨盾表面刻着骨翼神族的族徽。
六对骨翼环绕一枚本命骨印。
骨盾与骨刃相撞时发出的巨响，震得整个正南分阵台都在剧烈颤抖，碰撞点的法则冲击波，将周围还在缠斗的血祭老兵和天工域护域队员全部震飞。
骨翼源帝从主阵台方向一步步走来。
六对骨翼在他背后完全展开。
他额头上的本命骨印亮到了前所未有的程度。
外部加固节点的法则连接还在，但他将一部分骨系法则分身留在了加固节点旁，本体则赶到了正南分阵台。
血喉的源尊巅峰战力，已超出项天齐和小七能应对的极限。
如果正南分阵台被彻底摧毁，整个防线将失去三分之一的传送能力，后续的防御战将陷入全面被动。
“骨翼源帝。你还活着。”
血喉收回骨刃，退后几步拉开距离。
他的表情比面对小七时凝重了数倍。
骨翼源帝在远古大战时期是太初神王座下的重要战力，以六对骨翼的骨系法则和木系法则双修闻名，战力虽不如太初本人，但在源帝境界中绝对是顶尖存在。
“你都没死，本帝怎么会死。”
骨翼源帝将白骨盾牌收回掌心，盾牌缩小成一面巴掌大的骨令，正是他在骨翼祖地留给大长老的那枚骨令，刚才的骨盾，便是从这枚骨令中瞬间激发的投影神通，“正南分阵台不是你能动的。
三座分阵台是防线核心，动一座，整个防线就塌一角。
你带着你的军团退回去，本帝不拦你。
但你要继续往前一步，本帝今天就把你这具血祭法则凝聚的肉身拆了。
当年能拆了你们血祭军团的前任军团长，如今也能拆了你。”

血喉没有立刻回应。
他在评估骨翼源帝的战力。
骨翼源帝是源帝中期修为，在极北冰原这种骨系法则，能发挥最大优势的环境中，战力还要再加至少三成。
他一个源尊巅峰，在骨翼源帝面前确实不够看。
但他同时也在评估骨翼源帝留在这里的代价。
骨翼源帝的本体离开外部加固节点，加固节点便只剩下青木源帝一个人。
青木源帝虽是源帝中期，但他的木系法则，在极北冰原严寒环境中同样受到天然压制，一个人维持外部加固的负荷极大。
如果外部加固节点出问题，邪神神王在封印核心的封印，虽被李衍道补上了轮回缺口，但外部加固一旦松动，邪神神王，被锁死前的意志渗透留下的残余献祭法则污染，仍有可能从封印外层向入口旧址扩散，对防线形成内外夹击。
血喉收起骨刃，挥手下令全军撤退。
他退得很干脆，没有丝毫拖泥带水。
血祭军团主力在几息之内，便从正南分阵台的废墟中全部撤出，沿着来时的冰缝原路返回，退至极北冰原外围。
但他们没有撤出极北冰原。
只是退到了骨翼源帝的威慑范围之外，在极北冰原外围扎营。
正南分阵台在血祭军团撤退后一片狼藉。
六根阵柱中三根被完全摧毁，剩下一根被血喉的第一刀余波震出了裂纹，只有小七脚下的那根，和另一根被天工域护域队拼死守住的勉强完好。
天工域护域队伤亡不小。
伤者超过数十人，阵亡者也有数人。
content_en:
At this moment, a white bone shield made of bone-white light patterns appeared out of thin air in front of Xiao Qi's eyebrows.
The surface of the bone shield is engraved with the emblem of the Bone Wing God Clan.
Six pairs of bone wings surround a natal bone seal.
The loud noise made when the bone shield collided with the bone blade caused the entire due south formation platform to tremble violently. The legal shock wave at the collision point knocked away all the blood sacrifice veterans and Tiangong domain guard members who were still fighting around them.
Bone Wing Origin Emperor walked step by step from the direction of the main formation.
Six pairs of bone wings were fully deployed behind him.
The natal bone mark on his forehead was brighter than ever before.
The law connection of the external reinforcement node is still there, but he left part of the bone system law clone next to the reinforcement node, and the main body rushed to the due south formation platform.
Bloodthroat's peak combat power of Yuan Zun has exceeded the limit that Xiang Tianqi and Xiao Qi can handle.
If the due south formation platform is completely destroyed, the entire defense line will lose one-third of its transmission capability, and subsequent defensive battles will fall into full passivity.
"Bone Wing Origin Emperor. You are still alive."
Bloodthroat retracted the bone blade and took a few steps back to distance himself.
His expression was several times more solemn than when he faced Xiao Qi.
During the ancient war, the Bone Wing Origin Emperor was an important combat force under the throne of the God of Taichu. He was famous for his six pairs of bone wings practicing both the Bone Law and the Wood Law. Although his combat power was not as good as Taichu himself, he was definitely a top existence in the realm of the Origin Emperor.
"You're not dead yet, how could this emperor die?"
The Bone Wing Origin Emperor took the bone shield back into his palm, and the shield shrunk into a palm-sized Bone Token. It was the Bone Token he left to the Great Elder in the Bone Wing Ancestral Land. The bone shield just now was the projection magical power instantly stimulated from this Bone Token, "You can't move the due south formation platform.
The three formation platforms are the core of the defense line. If one is moved, the entire defense line will collapse.
You lead your army back, and I will not stop you.
But if you continue to take a step forward, this emperor will dismantle your physical body condensed by the law of blood sacrifice today.
The former commander of the Blood Sacrifice Legion who was able to dismantle you back then can also dismantle you now. "
Bloodthroat did not respond immediately.
He was evaluating the Bone Wing Origin Emperor's combat power.
The Bone Wing Origin Emperor is a mid-stage Origin Emperor. In an environment like the extreme northern ice plain where the bone system law can exert its greatest advantage, the combat power will be increased by at least 30%.
He is a peak Origin Master, but he is really not good enough in front of the Bone Wing Origin Emperor.
But he was also evaluating the cost of Bone Wing Origin Emperor staying here.
The body of the Bone Wing Gentei left the external reinforcement node, and only Aoki Gentei was left in the reinforcement node.
Although Gentei Aoki is in the middle stage of Gentei, his wood-based laws are also naturally suppressed in the severe cold environment of the arctic ice field. It is a huge load for one person to maintain external reinforcement.
If there is a problem with the external reinforcement node, although the seal of the Evil God King at the core of the seal has been filled by Li Yandao, once the external reinforcement is loosened, the Evil God King will still be contaminated by the remaining sacrificial law left by the penetration of the will before the lock. It is still possible to spread from the outer layer of the seal to the old entrance site, forming an internal and external attack on the defense line.
Bloodthroat put away the bone blade and waved his hand to order the entire army to retreat.
He retreated very cleanly, without any sloppiness.
Within a few breaths, the main force of the Blood Sacrifice Legion withdrew from the ruins of the formation platform due south, returned along the original path of the ice cracks, and retreated to the periphery of the extreme northern ice field.
But they did not withdraw from the Arctic ice sheet.
They just retreated beyond the intimidation range of the Bone Wing Origin Emperor and set up camp on the periphery of the extreme northern ice sheet.
The due south formation platform was in a mess after the Blood Sacrifice Legion retreated.
Three of the six formation pillars were completely destroyed, and the remaining one was cracked by the aftermath of Xue Maw's first sword. Only the one under Xiao Qi's feet and the other one that was desperately guarded by the Tiangong Domain Guards were barely intact.
The Tiangong domain protection team suffered a lot of casualties.
There were more than dozens of injured people and several people were killed.
